# Agentic Life OS (ALOS) — Discoverability Spec

This file defines the active modules, substrates, and agent capabilities of Frank's unified Life Operating System.

## Architecture
- Machine: Local Development Workstation (Windows)
- SIP Version: 1.1.1
- System Version: 1.0.0

## Interconnected Modules

### agentic-business-os (`business`)
- Path: `packages/business`
- Status: `in-development`
- Risk Level: `production`
- Health Command: `vitest run`
- Active Agents: Claude Code, Codex
- Description: Business operations, legal corporate compliance, Dutch BV ops (Arcanea Labs BV), and claim safeguards.

### agentic-creator-os (`creator`)
- Path: `packages/creator`
- Status: `in-development`
- Risk Level: `production`
- Health Command: `vitest run`
- Active Agents: Claude Code, Cursor, Antigravity
- Description: Multi-agent content engine, workshops OS, visual assets design, and Suno AI music production pipelines.

### second-brain-os (`memory`)
- Path: `packages/memory`
- Status: `in-development`
- Risk Level: `private`
- Health Command: `vitest run`
- Active Agents: Claude Code, Codex
- Description: Persistent knowledge storage, double-vault air-gapped Obsidian summaries, and chat history distillations.

### agentic-orchestration-os (`orchestration`)
- Path: `packages/orchestration`
- Status: `in-development`
- Risk Level: `production`
- Health Command: `vitest run`
- Active Agents: Claude Code, Antigravity
- Description: Ecosystem orchestration, package dependency checks, custom ZSH/PowerShell toolkits, and command grids.

### agentic-investor-os (`investor`)
- Path: `packages/investor`
- Status: `in-development`
- Risk Level: `private`
- Health Command: `vitest run`
- Active Agents: Claude Code
- Description: Sovereign wealth calculation, capital allocation, deal scouting, due diligence, and investment tracking.

### agentic-health-os (`health`)
- Path: `packages/health`
- Status: `in-development`
- Risk Level: `private`
- Health Command: `vitest run`
- Active Agents: Claude Code, Gemini
- Description: Biomedical research query gateways integrating OpenFDA, dbSNP, ChEMBL, ClinicalTrials, and AlphaFold structure lookups.

### agentic-family-os (`family`)
- Path: `packages/family`
- Status: `in-development`
- Risk Level: `private`
- Health Command: `pnpm exec vitest run packages/family/tests`
- Active Agents: Hermes, Claude Code
- Description: Evidence-backed private family research, human-governed relationship claims, audience-scoped ancestor projections, preservation, and stewardship.
